answer: Agents selling meadow surveys may submit spiral flight logs and zenith images. Their settlement committee should count bonded credits, not signing keys: each credit belongs to one validator allocation until an unbonding delay ends. A certificate needs two thirds of all bonded weight, and conflicting signatures expose stake to slashing. Splitting a bond across aliases adds no weight. An attacker must acquire substantial capital and risk its loss to certify conflicting payments. This requires verifiable equivocation proofs and an exit delay longer than the challenge window.
